extracted.intended_audience: Principal investigators, department grants administrators, and subcontract PIs preparing NIH R21/R33 (SF424 Research & Related) budgets and budget justifications
extracted.subtask_description: Fill out the Research & Related budget (Sections A–K) and prepare the Budget Justification for an NIH R21/R33 application, including subaward budgets, personnel and consultant justifications, travel, equipment, participant support, other direct costs, and indirect costs documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section A — Senior/Key Person
rubrics_metrics.description: List each senior/key person with prefix, first/middle/last name, suffix, project role, base salary ($), calendar/academic/summer months, salary ($), benefits ($), and funds requested ($); report total funds requested for all senior/key persons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Fields include: Prefix, First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, Suffix, Project Role, Base Salary ($), Cal. Months, Acad. Months, Sum. Months, Salary ($), Benefits ($), Funds Requested ($). Provide totals and add additional senior/key persons in the attached file as needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section B — Other Personnel
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify number and roles of other personnel (e.g., postdoctoral associates, graduate students, undergraduate students, secretarial/clerical), calendar/academic/summer months, requested salary, fringe benefits, and funds requested; provide totals for other personnel and for salary, wages and fringe benefits (A+B).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report counts and effort (months) for each personnel category, itemize salary and fringe per person or group, and compute totals. Example rows: Post Doctoral Associates, Graduate Students, Undergraduate Students, Secretarial/Clerical. Total Other Personnel and Total Salary, Wages and Fringe Benefits must be shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section C — Equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: List equipment items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000; include total funds requested for all equipment listed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit threshold: 'List items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000'. Provide itemized equipment descriptions and amounts, and a Total Equipment line. Additional equipment may be attached in a separate file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section D — Travel
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide travel costs broken out into Domestic Travel Costs (including Canada, Mexico and U.S. possessions) and Foreign Travel Costs, and report total travel cost.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Itemize planned travel by domestic vs foreign. The budget justification should explain purpose and amounts (examples in this application: $2,000/year for PI travel in R21; $3,000/year in R33 to support attendance at one national meeting and to allow subcontract PIs to attend a program team meeting).

rubrics_metrics.name: Section E — Participant/Trainee Support Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Itemize participant/trainee support: Tuition/Fees/Health Insurance, Stipends, Travel, Subsistence, Other; include number of participants/trainees and total participant/trainee support costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report counts and per-item costs; include totals. Use separate lines for tuition/fees/insurance, stipends, travel, subsistence, and other. Provide number of participants/trainees to justify totals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section F — Other Direct Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Itemize other direct costs, including Materials and Supplies, Publication Costs, Consultant Services, ADP/Computer Services, Subawards/Consortium/Contractual Costs, Equipment or Facility Rental/User Fees, Alterations and Renovations, Tuition Remission Fees, and any other direct cost categories; compute total other direct costs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide line-item detail and amounts for each category. Subawards/consortium costs should be itemized separately. Ensure totals roll into Direct Costs (Section G).

rubrics_metrics.name: Section G — Direct Costs Total
rubrics_metrics.description: Report Total Direct Costs (sum of Sections A through F).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Compute and display the total direct costs derived from the detailed section subtotals (A thru F).

rubrics_metrics.name: Section H — Indirect Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Indirect Cost Type, Indirect Cost Rate (%), Indirect Cost Base ($) (e.g., Modified Total Direct Cost), funds requested for indirect costs, and identify cognizant federal agency (agency name, POC name, and POC phone number).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specify the indirect cost base and rate (example: MTDC 54.50). Include cognizant agency contact (example entries: 'DHHS, Robert Aaronson, 212-264-2069' or for UCSD 'DHHS Office of Inspector General, Region IX, Office of Audit Services, 50 United Nations Plaza... 415-437-7820'). Show rate periods if they vary across budget years (example: 'UR’s approved F&A Rate is 53% for the period 03/01/11 - 06/30/11, and 54.5% thereafter').

rubrics_metrics.name: Section I — Total Direct and Indirect Costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Report Total Direct and Indirect Institutional Costs (G + H).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Add Direct Costs (Section G) and Indirect Costs (Section H) to calculate the overall institutional cost requested for the project period or budget period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section J — Fee
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate any Fee funds requested (if applicable) and report amount.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter Fee funds requested under Section J; include justification in the budget justification if required by the FOA or sponsor rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Section K — Budget Justification (attachment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a narrative Budget Justification explaining personnel roles and effort, consultant roles, travel purposes, other costs, and overhead calculations; attach a single budget justification file (Only attach one file).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Budget Justification should include: PERSONNEL JUSTIFICATION (roles, person months/percent effort, responsibilities, qualifications), CONSULTANTS (roles, qualifications, tasks), travel justification (amounts and purposes), other costs explanation, and overhead/F&A rate documentation (rate percentages, effective dates, and cognizant agency contact). Example text: 'PERSONNEL JUSTIFICATION: ... PI Dr. Steve Dewhurst (PI, 1.2 person months) ... ROLE: His role on the project is to oversee all of the experiments...' and 'Overhead calculations UR’s approved F&A Rate is 53% ... and 54.5% thereafter. UR’s cognizant agency contact is: DHHS, Robert Aaronson, Tel: ... The date of its most recent indirect cost rate negotiation agreement is: 01/21/2009.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment dollar threshold rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Equipment must be listed if the item exceeds $5,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit instruction in the equipment section: 'List items and dollar amount for each item exceeding $5,000'. Items under $5,000 should be budgeted under Materials and Supplies (Section F).

rubrics_metrics.name: Subaward (Consortium) budget requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Subaward organizations must submit their own Research & Related budget for each budget period (Sections A–K) including senior/key persons, other personnel, equipment, travel, participant support, other direct costs, indirect costs (with rate and base), totals, and a budget justification file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subaward entries include organization name, start/end dates, budget period, and may show their own indirect cost rate (example: UCSD showing 54.50 MTDC). Subaward budget pages in this document repeat the full A–K structure. Include cognizant agency contact for the subaward and attach the subaward's budget justification file (example filename: '1243-FINALBUDG-JUST-UCSD[1].pdf').

rubrics_metrics.name: Cumulative Budget Totals
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide cumulative totals across budget periods for Sections A–J (e.g., total salary/wages/fringe, total equipment, total travel domestic/foreign, total participant support categories, total other direct costs, total direct costs, total indirect costs, total direct + indirect).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include a cumulative budget table summarizing totals across all budget periods and subawards to present the entire project cost. Example headings in document: 'Cumulative Budget Totals ($)' with section subtotals listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personnel Justification content expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: Budget justification must describe each key person's role, person-months or percent effort, relevant qualifications/experience, responsibility on the project, collaborative relationships, and any changes in effort across phases (R21 vs R33).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples provided: 'Dr. Steve Dewhurst (PI, 1.2 person months) ... His role on the project is to oversee all of the experiments, reporting and administrative/financial responsibilities, and to interface with the other participating investigators.' Also: 'Effort will increase to 1.8 calendar months in the R33 phase, reflecting increased volume of work.' For other personnel (postdoc, technician) include planned duties, FTE, year-by-year changes (e.g., technician 50% FTE in year 2, increased to 12 months in R33).

rubrics_metrics.name: Consultant Justification content expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe consultant(s) name, affiliation, role on the project (e.g., reviewer, technical advisor), specific tasks they will perform, and justification of expertise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example language: 'Consultant ... will serve as a consultant and advisor to the research program, to review annual progress reports, participate in data evaluations, and to provide technical assistance and guidance on assessments...' Provide consultant qualifications and how their services will be used.

rubrics_metrics.name: Travel Justification content expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain travel amounts and purposes in the budget justification (e.g., attendance at a national meeting, program team meetings, subcontract PI travel), and provide per-year amounts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document examples: 'We are requesting a small amount of travel funds ($2,000/year) to support attendance of the PI at one national meeting, and to allow Dr. Yang ... to attend an annual program team meeting in Rochester.' For R33: '$3,000/year' described similarly. Provide reason and expected attendees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indirect Cost Rate documentation and effective date
rubrics_metrics.description: Document the institution's approved F&A (indirect) rate(s) for specified periods, the applicable base (e.g., MTDC), the date of the indirect cost rate negotiation agreement, and cognizant agency contact information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include rate percent and effective dates (example: 'UR’s approved F&A Rate is 53% for the period 03/01/11 - 06/30/11, and 54.5% thereafter' and 'date of its most recent indirect cost rate negotiation agreement is: 01/21/2009'). Provide cognizant federal agency name and POC (examples in document).

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative/metadata requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Include administrative identifiers and dates: Organizational DUNS, Budget Type, Organization name, Budget Period Start/End Dates, Tracking Number, Funding Opportunity Number, Received Date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples present on each page: 'ORGANIZATIONAL DUNS:*', 'Budget Type:', 'Enter name of Organization:', '* Start Date:', '* End Date:', 'Tracking Number: GRANT10650670', 'Funding Opportunity Number: RFA-AI-10-011', 'Received Date: 2010-07-09T11:07:08-04:00'. Ensure these are filled for each applicant and subaward.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single-file budget justification attachment rule
rubrics_metrics.description: Only one budget justification file should be attached for the Research & Related Budget (indicated by 'Only attach one file.').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The form explicitly notes '(Only attach one file.)' for the Budget Justification field; when submitting, consolidate justification content into a single PDF attachment as required.
